VoteDuration.label: Vote duration (seconds)
VoteDuration.description: How long the map vote remains open, up to 60 seconds.

IgnoreSpec.label: Ignore spectators
IgnoreSpec.description: Exclude spectators when calculating vote participation.

AllowRtv.label: Allow RTV
AllowRtv.description: Allow players to request an early map vote.

UseGameTimeLimit.label: Use game time limit
UseGameTimeLimit.description: Use the game's map time limit to trigger the map change.

RTVPercent.label: RTV required ratio
RTVPercent.description: Player ratio required for RTV, from 0 to 1.

RTVDelay.label: RTV delay (minutes)
RTVDelay.description: Wait this many minutes after map start before allowing RTV.

EnforceTimeLimit.label: Enforce time limit
EnforceTimeLimit.description: Have the plugin enforce its map-change flow at the time limit.

ChangeMapUse_host_workshop_map.label: Use host_workshop_map
ChangeMapUse_host_workshop_map.description: Use the host_workshop_map command when changing to Workshop maps.

DisplayHudTimeleftRemaining.label: HUD countdown threshold (seconds)
DisplayHudTimeleftRemaining.description: Show the HUD countdown below this remaining time; 0 disables it.

RunOfFVote.label: Enable runoff vote
RunOfFVote.description: Start a runoff vote when the first result does not meet the requirement.

VotePercent.label: Vote required ratio
VotePercent.description: Ratio required for a winning option, from 0 to 1.

VoteStartSound.label: Vote start sound
VoteStartSound.description: Sound resource path played when voting starts.
